tree.kind: verbatim copy of the repository's whole skill directory, skills/humanizer-ru, unpacked from the tag's tarball; this repository carries no other skill

used_by: src/commahum/skill.py: finds the skill, reads its name out of the frontmatter, refuses a run without it
src/commahum/pi_runner.py: hands it to pi with --skill and opens every prompt with its invocation; appends the files its flow reads
src/commahum/bans.py: refuses a rewrite that introduces a hard ban the original did not have
src/commahum/rewrite.py: the role, the register and the reply protocol; the rules themselves are the skill's own text
how_to_refresh: Write a script that downloads https://codeload.github.com/ilyautov/humanizer-ru/tar.gz/refs/tags/<tag>, unpacks skills/humanizer-ru/, recomputes this file's sha256 map over the unpacked bytes and rewrites the revision; tests/test_skill.py compares the checkout against this map, so a copy that drifted from the pin fails the suite. Refresh the map and the checkout together.
note: The scanner needs razdel and pymorphy3; the rewriting pipeline reads only the ban table, through ast, and imports none of the skill's code. Files at the top of this directory that the skill does not have: LICENSE.humanizer-ru and MANIFEST.json.
